messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — memory/KV OOM recurring pattern. Root cause hypothesis: small persistent shard allocations + fragmentation + GC not reclaiming dead caches. Need owners for profiling, slab tuning, eviction policy, and canary. Assign and timelines below.

mina: I'll own the sampling + profiler runs. I'll spin up micro-sampler across 3 affected shards.

ryan: I'll take heapdump + flamegraph for s05 and s08. Running: `rdwctl profile --shard s05 --duration 10m --sample=0.25 > s05.prof` ; will upload to /artifacts/oom/4819012345/

sarah: I'll prototype slab size changes and GC threshold bump. Proposal: reduce slab_class_3 from 64KB->48KB and GC trigger from 70%->60% usage in canary.

julio: I'll implement tenant-level soft ceilings so single tenant can't hold >40% of shard cache. Will prepare canary config and rollout plan.

eng-oncall-bot: ALERT SUMMARY: 3 OOMs in last 24h on shard s05,s08,s12. Peak RSS before crash: 12.6GB; resident trend shows step increases every 6-8h.

alex: Action list (owner -> task -> due):
- mina -> run micro-sampler across s05,s08,s12, collect traces (due +48h)
- ryan -> heapdumps + flamegraphs + upload (due +24h)
- sarah -> bench slab tweak + perf test in canary (due +72h)
- julio -> tenant soft-ceil PR + canary rollout plan (due +72h)
- ops -> add temporary hard OOM guard at 95% RSS for affected pool (owner: @oncall) (due ASAP)

mina: started sampler job: `rdwctl micro-sample --shards s05,s08,s12 --rate 1/60 --out /tmp/micro` ; ETA 3h

ryan: uploaded s05.prof and flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/oom/4819012345/s05.flame.html

sarah: perf test notes: smaller slabs reduce fragmentation in lab by ~12% on synthetic workload; still seeing long tail allocations from prefix_cache. Suggest add prefix eviction TTL.

julio: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/kv/merge_requests/4567 ; canary config attached. will schedule canary tomorrow 0100 UTC.

alex: agreed on TTL for prefix_cache (30m) + will add to runbook. Also schedule 15min sync tomorrow 0200 UTC to check canary metrics. Please add checkin comments here when done. :thumbsup:

ryan: noted, will post flamegraphs for other shards as they finish.

mina: sampler finished, uploaded traces to /artifacts/oom/4819012345/micros/ ; looking at samples now, will share top suspects in 2h.

sarah: I'll draft the runbook snippet for 'OOM during KV growth' including steps: collect heapdump, enable emergency eviction, rollback PR. Will paste here.

alex: thanks all. looping in @eng-sre for ops guardrail follow-through.
